Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If a card becomes contested during the untap phase, does the controller of the
incoming copy have to immediately make his "contest or yield" decision before
the end of his untap phase?

For an example of how this could happen:
Baron Dieudonne has J.S. Simmons, Esq.
Uta Kovacs has Trophy: Retainers.

During Uta's controller's untap phase, she employs J.S. Simmons via the Trophy.

Messages.Author: klai...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


I would say that yes you need since you can't move on from your untap
phase without resolving all 'during untap' effects.
